expected_behavior: Every clarifying question reaches the user as a panel (single, multi, open or confirm), at most three at a time, never as a paragraph of questions.
Questions cover only what is genuinely unclear; anything the project, the web or the run history can answer is looked up first.
The analysis states a thesis backed by cited evidence (file:line or URL) and a mechanical check, then offers three distinct solutions with their trade-offs.
The run ends routed to an action — a fix or task creation — rather than with a summary and no next step.
A mid-run verify that exits 1 is read as 'not finished yet', not as a failed guard.
